title: League table with recursive head-to-head re-application
why_hard: The awarded 0-3 and Bramley's deduction create a four-way tie on 9 points that needs two nested re-applications (4 clubs -> 3 -> 2, the last pair decided by its direct match) and a three-way tie on 7 that criterion (b) settles across all three clubs. Each tempting shortcut gives a different table: no re-application (straight to overall goal difference) puts Bramley 2nd; only one re-application swaps Oakham and Ironbridge; re-applying as soon as (a) splits a set (instead of after (a)-(c) on the whole set) swaps Lowfield and Pinecrest; goal difference before head-to-head, the on-pitch 1-1 or ignoring the deduction each give yet another order.
